title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
550 HIGH STREET • P.O. BOX 220 • JACKSON, MS 39205-0220
TELEPHONE (601) 359-3860 • FAX (601) 359-2003


November 20, 2025
Scott S. Harris, Esq.
Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, N.E.
Washington, D.C. 20543
Re: Watson v. Republican National Committee, No. 24-1260
Dear Mr. Harris:
The petition for a writ of certiorari in the above-captioned case was granted on
November 10, 2025. Petitioner’s opening brief is currently due on December 26, 2025,
respondents’ briefs on January 26, 2026, and reply briefs on February 25, 2026.
Because of the press of other cases, the parties respectfully request, under this
Court’s Rule 30.4, that the time within which to file petitioner’s brief (and the joint
appendix and any brief by a respondent supporting petitioner) be extended to and
including January 2, 2026, and the time within which to file respondents’ briefs be
extended to and including February 9, 2026. If those requests are granted, reply
briefs would be due March 11, 2026. This schedule would allow the case to be heard
in the Court’s March sitting.
All parties consent to this briefing schedule.
Very truly yours,
/s Scott G. Stewart
Scott G. Stewart
Counsel for Petitioner
cc:  Gilbert Charles Dickey
T. Russell Nobile
Timothy Charles Holleman
Marc Erik Elias
Counsel for Respondents
